name: Lady Anacondra
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lady Anacondra holds to the Druids of the Fang. She followed Naralex in his effort to heal the Barrens, but his communion with the Emerald Dream became a nightmare. It shattered her mind and turned her devotion toward remaking the land in the dream’s image.

sections.title: From Disciple to Serpent
sections.body: Lady Anacondra followed Naralex into the caverns as he sought the Barrens’ subterranean springs through the Emerald Dream. Then dark visions seized his mind, and the nightmare spread from the dreaming realm to his disciples. Her sanity broke. Her hope for the land became a cold, reptilian obsession.

sections.title: A Fanglord in the Deep
sections.body: Lady Anacondra guards the Wailing Caverns’ first chambers. She and the other Fanglords have cast aside the Cenarion Circle’s teachings and embraced the viper’s vicious ways. She wields lightning and nature magic, and keeps Naralex in his twisted sleep with slumbering trances. Above, the nightmare’s corruption still threatens the Barrens.

faq.answer: Lady Anacondra began as a night elf druid who followed Naralex in his effort to heal the Barrens. His nightmare corrupted his disciples.

faq.q: Why did she turn against the Cenarion Circle?
aliases: how did she become a druid of the fang
faq.answer: A nightmare overcame Naralex’s attempt to reach the Emerald Dream beneath the Barrens. It infected his acolytes, corrupting Lady Anacondra and turning her toward the twisted dream.

faq.q: What is her role in the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra is one of the four Fanglords leading the Druids of the Fang. She guards the caverns’ upper reaches and helps keep Naralex trapped in corrupted sleep as the Fang work to remake the land in their dream’s image.

faq.q: Where can she be found inside the caverns?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra roams the first large network of caverns near the Wailing Caverns’ entrance. She patrols among the raptors and serpents, moving between several resting places.

faq.q: What item is taken from her for the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra carries the Gem of Anacondra. Nara Wildmane, a druid in Thunder Bluff, needs the gem to break the Fanglords’ hold over the Barrens.

faq.q: What powers does she wield in battle?
faq.answer: Lady Anacondra wields nature magic, striking from afar with bolts of lightning. She can also cast magical slumber to incapacitate invaders while her reptilian allies attack.

angles.text: For Cenarion druids, Lady Anacondra’s story is a tragedy. Her zeal to heal the land left her open to the nightmare that turned her communion into madness.
As a night elf, you may see a sister of Kaldorei lineage who cast aside her heritage and form to pursue a twisted serpentine dream. Her fate warns of dangers within the Emerald Dream.
As a member of the Horde, you must protect the Barrens’ delicate lifelines from Lady Anacondra and the Fanglords. Removing her is critical to securing Crossroads and the nearby oases.
